## Android 16 and 17 compatibility

- LibRedirect Mobile now targets Android 17 (API 37) and builds with Android SDK Platform 37.2. The same APK supports Android 16 (API 36), Android 17, and Android 17 QPR2 (API 37.2).
- Android 8.0 (API 26) is the minimum supported version.
- The release APK's native libraries and packaging were checked for 16 KB memory page alignment. The connected test suite also runs on a 16 KB Android 17 QPR2 emulator.

## Background audio on Android 17

When background audio is enabled and a page starts playing media, the in-app browser now starts the media foreground service while the app is visible on Android 17. This lets Android grant the service the access it needs to continue playback when you leave the app. The media notification provides play, pause, and stop controls.

## Build and verification

- Android CI runs device tests on API 28, 36, 37.0, and 37.2, including a regression test for when the media service starts on Android 17.
- Download the signed APK and its SHA-256 checksum from the release assets. Obtainium can also install and track releases from the same GitHub repository.
- Android version code is 25.
